# vector spec exports

Refuse a new export its contract does not cover.

## Usage

```text
vector spec exports <contract.json> [flags]
```

## Arguments

<scalar-field name="&lt;contract.json&gt;" required>

the contract

</scalar-field>

## Flags

<scalar-field name="--base" type="&lt;ref&gt;">

the commit the change is against

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="--nish-root" type="&lt;dir&gt;">

a nish checkout: finds the module and the compiler

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="--format" type="&lt;f&gt;">

text (default), markdown (a PR comment) or json

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="-h, --help">

Show this command's help, and exit 0.

</scalar-field>
